title: Pre-order upcoming games, and send friend requests
excerpt: Seven upcoming games are up for pre-order, with a release calendar on the home page. Pre-load three days early and play on release day. Adding a friend now sends a request they can accept, and you can set yourself to away or invisible.

title: The store just got a lot bigger: 90+ games across 19 categories
excerpt: From roguelikes and horror to fighting games, racing sims and free-to-play shooters, there is now something for every kind of player. Browse by category from the home page.

title: The Mega Sale is live: up to 75% off
excerpt: Red Dead Redemption 2 and Hogwarts Legacy lead this week's deals, with dozens of games discounted across the store.

title: Your library now tracks playtime
excerpt: See how long you have played each game and when you last launched it, then sort your library by recent activity.

title: Battlefield 2042 joins the featured lineup
excerpt: 128-player battles and dynamic weather are now front and centre on the Discover page, alongside F1 22 and FIFA 23.

title: Save games for later with wishlists
excerpt: Tap the + on any game card to add it to your wishlist. Sale prices appear on your wishlist automatically.

title: Spotlight: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II
excerpt: Task Force 141 is back. Catch up on the campaign, Special Ops and multiplayer before the next season starts.
